apps.subtitle: Torrent streaming client
apps.localizedDescription: Torrent streaming client for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS and Mac (Catalyst), written in SwiftUI. Streams come from Stremio-compatible addons and play through a vendored libtorrent engine feeding VLC.

versions.localizedDescription:
Mostly stuff you asked for.

- You don't need an account anymore. There's a "Continue as guest" button on the login screen. Everything you watch is saved on the device, and if you make an account later it all gets moved over.
- The iPhone app rotates now. Before it was stuck in portrait unless you were in the player.
- Cleaned up the Profile tab. Email is readable now, there's one Edit Profile button, and switching/adding profiles and signing out moved into the menu at the top right.
- Also has the fixes from 1.0.1 (play button missing on iOS 18, "don't have permission to save the file" on Apple TV).

Install

Mac: open the dmg, drag to Applications. It's notarized so it just opens.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, use Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.
